workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix: accept no-op generation controls and explain upstream failures. Target files: dist/llm-proxy.js, index.js, index.test.js. The unsupported-control guard rejected any non-`undefined` value, so VS Code's `n: 1` returned `400 Unsupported generation controls: n.` and every request failed. Several SDKs also send `null` for each unset optional field and hit the same wall (I verified `n: null`, `stop: null` and `frequency_penalty: null` all failed the same way). (Ref: https://github.com/KochC/opencode-llm-proxy/pull/118)

workarounds.symptom: Spurious 'failed to load plugin' error on opencode 1.18.x (cosmetic — proxy still works); one-line V1 default export silences it
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(plugin): add V1 default export descriptor to stop legacy loader probing every helper. Target files: dist/llm-proxy.js, index.js, index.test.js. Adds a V1 plugin descriptor as the default export of `index.js` (and the rebuilt `dist/llm-proxy.js`): (Ref: https://github.com/KochC/opencode-llm-proxy/pull/89)

workarounds.symptom: Tool/function calling (v1.7.0) doesn't trigger against a real OpenCode server — bridge MCP server never registers
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix: disable stale bridge tool IDs from other pool slots. Target files: index.js, index.test.js. . Fixes a bug where tool/function calling (#52/v1.7.0) can return the *wrong* tool call — a stale one from a previously-reused bridge pool slot — instead of the current turn's own tool. (Ref: https://github.com/KochC/opencode-llm-proxy/pull/56)
